article.title: The specificity of neo-fascism
article.author: Prabhat Patnaik
article.content: If democracy is to be preserved in the country, then the struggle for democracy, instead of accepting the attitude of the judiciary as it exists at any given time, must incorporate a struggle for sensitizing the judiciary to the fundamental need for consciously going beyond an inherited hierarchical perception of society. The post The specificity of neo-fascism appeared first on MR Online .
